name: Grid Path Combinatorics
description: Replaces the functional composition constraint with a combinatorial grid path condition (number of shortest paths from (0,0) to (x_u, x_v) is exactly 3). This requires models to evaluate the combinations of x_u, x_v in {1,2} to discover it enforces x_u != x_v, defeating models that rely on explicitly matching opposite-color or boolean-logic keywords.
